lead: An `nvs-types` fixture reaches the checker and never the declaration pass, so a casing or visibility refusal is invisible to every helper in `crates/nvs-types/tests/common/mod.rs`.
body: `check_src` and its siblings run `parse_file` → `resolve_file` → `check_program`, and `check_declarations` — where `rule:core-api/identifier-casing` is answered — is in none of them, so the fixture reads an empty `Diagnostics` and looks like unbuilt work. Call `common::check_declarations_only` for a declaration-shape refusal.
